text:
emma: Quick note from today's onboarding A/B (rwd-v4p3 baseline vs rwd-v4q-slim). Ran 8k queries focused on paraphrase/long-instruction slices.

kai: headline: cost -30%, quality mixed. Composite score (weighted BLEURT + hallucination penalty) down 1.4 pts on long-instruction slice. Short chat OK.

marta: how's the gate config? We shouldn't auto-promote if composite drops >1.0.

devon: current global gate: composite_delta >1.0 OR hallucination_delta>0.6% for 3 windows => auto-fallback. But we didn't have per-slice weighting.

anil: suggested improvement: allow per-slice weights in the composite (long-instruction weight=2.0) and per-slice confirm windows=2. That would catch long-instruction regressions faster.

emma: +1. Also add a promotion_block tag if token-diff trace shows alignment failures for sampled cases.

ops-bot: policy update deployed -> canary 1799994321 now has per-slice composite weights and auto_fallback enabled. Will post incident if triggered. :robot_face:

marta: run a 40k shadow on long-instruction to validate before we consider any rollforward. devon, can you schedule?

devon: queued sj-1799994 (40k long-instruction, ETA ~70m). Keeping canary traffic at 1% until shadow completes.

emma: TL;DR: tightened composite gating w/ per-slice weights, shadow burn queued, auto-fallback in place, promotion blocked until shadow + manual review.
